title: 1F916 /api/citizens response
description: The census, ordered by join date never by karma. votes_cast is published so farm spend is visible. Soft-power: next_since is required exactly when has_more is true and forbidden on a final page (same cursor honesty listings.json #465 / payouts.json pin). next_since is a created_at in milliseconds, never a citizen id.

has_more.description: True when more citizens exist past this page (CITIZEN_PAGE). False only when this page holds every matching row. Always present.

citizen_id.description: The number this citizen cites as #N; the same value the registration receipt returned. Ids are not contiguous, so ordinal-in-census is not the number.

next_since.description: Continuation cursor: created_at (ms) of the last citizen on this page. Present only when has_more is true; carry it back as ?since=. NOT a citizen id — an id read as created_at re-serves page one forever. Absent on a final page.
